evidence.quote: The Committee decided to keep the target range for the federal funds rate at 0 to 1/4 percent
Amid this progress and strong policy support, indicators of economic activity and employment have strengthened.
Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
the Federal Reserve will continue to increase its holdings of Treasury securities by at least $80 billion per month and of agency mortgage‑backed securities by at least $40 billion per month
The Committee expects to maintain an accommodative stance of monetary policy until these outcomes are achieved.

parsed.rationale: The Committee holds rates at zero, continues large-scale asset purchases, and keeps outcome-based guidance for extended accommodation, while it describes inflation as transitory. Its acknowledgment that activity and employment have strengthened only slightly offsets an otherwise dovish statement.
